tasks.brief: Implement src/services/llm.py: Define constant FALLBACK_REPLY = 'The language model is currently unavailable. Please try again in a moment.' Define function generate_reply(message: str) -> str. Inside generate_reply, read LLM_ENDPOINT, LLM_MODEL, LLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT, LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS from os.environ at call time (defaults: 'http://localhost:1234/v1/chat/completions', 'local-model', '', 120). Construct request body: {"model": LLM_MODEL, "messages": ([{"role": "system", "content": LLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT}] if LLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT else []) + [{"role": "user", "content": message}], "stream": false}. Use httpx.Client().post(LLM_ENDPOINT, json=request_body, timeout=float(LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)). On success (response.status_code == 200), extract data = response.json(); content = data.get("choices", [{}])[0].get("message", {}).get("content"); if content: return content. On any exception (httpx.HTTPError, json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, IndexError, ValueError) or non-2xx status, return FALLBACK_REPLY. No other imports or symbols exported. Acceptance: generate_reply('test') with mocked httpx returning 200 with valid JSON returns the content string; with connection error returns FALLBACK_REPLY; with non-2xx returns FALLBACK_REPLY; with malformed JSON returns FALLBACK_REPLY; with empty content returns FALLBACK_REPLY; with timeout returns FALLBACK_REPLY. Config is read at call time.
tasks.smoke_check: python3 -c "from src.services.llm import generate_reply, FALLBACK_REPLY; assert callable(generate_reply); assert isinstance(FALLBACK_REPLY, str)"

tasks.brief: Rewrite src/api/chat.py: Import generate_reply from src.services.llm. Define FastAPI APIRouter. Define Pydantic model ChatRequest with field message: str and ChatResponse with field reply: str. Define POST /api/v1/chat endpoint. Endpoint accepts request body of type ChatRequest. Call generate_reply(request.message). Return ChatResponse(reply=result). Remove the old echo import and usage. Acceptance: POST /api/v1/chat with {"message": "test"} returns 200 with {'reply': 'mocked_reply'} (mock generate_reply via env var pointing at a fake upstream); POST with missing message returns 422; GET / returns HTML page containing '/api/v1/chat'.
